work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. LXXVI synopsis/selfprotocol 56313–56331 and §§1–7 run to dating 56658–56662. Exclude 56336–56342: its omitted constitution of the same military Order follows the preceding Malta text, whereas this act concerns Montesia; the present source note is explicitly numbered 2 at 56344. Retain all internal readings 56413–56414,56509–56515,56567–56575,56626–56629. The reading at 56689–56691, below the LXXVII opening, mechanically quotes Quibus omnibus ... illorum sufficienti derogatione from this act 56642–56647 and is attached here as a disjoint range.
